Post 1
📈 ASX 200 surged 230.60pts or 2.61% to 9,065.10 Thursday, hitting a 20-day high. Tech led the charge with NXT up 50.84%. Energy was the lone wreck. A session of sharp winners and sharper losers. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🟢 IT +10.09%, Materials +7.55%, Health Care +3.64%. 🔴 Energy -4.76%, Utilities -1.51%, Financials -0.29%. Tech and miners drove the rally; oil names dragged hard. #ASX #ausbiz #energy #mining

Post 3
NXT closed at AUD 9.85, up 50.84% — the session's defining move. Catalyst Metals surged 18.34%. On the other side, Eagers Automotive fell 13.22% to AUD 16.61. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 5,897.05/oz. Silver AUD 75.20/oz. AUD/USD at 0.7017. Metals strength backed the Materials rally. WDS fell 6.02%, STO 5.41% as energy commodities weighed. #gold #metals #ASX

Post 5
ASX sits 2.49% off its 52-week high. Can IT and Materials hold the lead? Watch energy — if oil stabilises, WDS and STO could snap back. Bulls or bears from here — what's your call? #ASX #ausbiz #investing
